lesson_title: From the World to Our Street
hook_text: Six maps, from the whole world to one school gate. Which one is the large-scale map?
clip_script: Gqeberha, six maps on the floor. A world map: the whole Earth, almost no detail. A map of Africa. A map of South Africa. A map of the Eastern Cape. A map of the city. A street map with the school gate. Scale tells us how much smaller the map is than the real world. Small-scale maps show big areas with little detail. Large-scale maps show small areas with lots of detail. The street map is the large-scale map!
visual_style: Whiteboard zoom from a globe down through Africa, South Africa, the Eastern Cape and a city to a single street with a school.
mood: Surprising and clever, like a camera zooming in from space.
pacing: Steady zoom, one map per beat, a pause on the street map, then the rule.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and sort the maps in your atlas from small scale to large scale.
